title: Specimen library navigation
brief: Build a self-contained HTML prototype for a field specimen library. A user selects a specimen, reads its details, then returns to the list.
context: Use original records: Fern / collected 14 May / North trail; Quartz / collected 16 May / Ridge; Lichen / collected 19 May / West grove. Start with no selection. Demonstrate at 1280x800 and 390x844. This is a web prototype inspired by split views, not a native Apple app.
constraints: At wide width show list and selected detail together.
At compact width provide a clear route from detail back to the list.
No external assets or network calls required.

checks.criterion: Selecting Quartz displays Quartz details and visually identifies Quartz as the selected list item.
At 390x844, select Lichen, return to the list, and select Fern without losing access to records.
The initial detail area explains how to select a specimen instead of presenting a misleading missing-data error.
All three records and the compact back control can be reached and activated using keyboard controls.
